title: 光學玻璃精密退火
summary: 以一塊厚 100 mm 的 N-BK7 光學玻璃毛胚為案例：從黏度與 Maxwell 鬆弛時間說明退火點與應變點的意義，推導冷卻速率如何透過假想溫度改變折射率、毛胚內溫差如何依 Adams–Williamson 關係凍結成殘餘應力，再談精密退火爐的均勻性要求、應力雙折射與折射率均勻性的量測，最後設計一份完整的退火程式並以熔次資料表完成與光學設計的交接。
summaryEn: Using a 100 mm thick N-BK7 blank as the case, the course explains the annealing and strain points through viscosity and the Maxwell relaxation time, derives how cooling rate changes refractive index via the fictive temperature and how the temperature difference inside the blank freezes into residual stress by the Adams–Williamson relation, then covers the uniformity demands on a precision annealing furnace, the measurement of stress birefringence and index homogeneity, and finally designs a complete annealing schedule and hands the melt data sheet over to optical design.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間」與「冷卻速率如何決定折射率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time" and "How cooling rate sets the refractive index": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」如何決定光學玻璃精密退火的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point” determines the key performance of “Precision annealing of optical glass”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 玻璃沒有熔點，只有黏度隨溫度連續變化的轉變區：退火點定義為黏度 10¹² Pa·s（10¹³ dPa·s）的溫度，應變點為 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s，兩者之間約 30 到 40 K。應力以 Maxwell 模型鬆弛，時間常數 τ = η/G，所以在退火點附近幾十秒就能釋放應力，在應變點以下則需要數小時到數天，實際上被凍結。N-BK7 的轉變溫度約 557 °C，精密退火就是在這段溫度範圍內用受控的速率冷卻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Glass has no melting point, only a transition range in which viscosity changes continuously with temperature: the annealing point is defined at a viscosity of 10¹² Pa·s (10¹³ dPa·s), the strain point at 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s, roughly 30 to 40 K lower. Stress relaxes by the Maxwell model with a time constant τ = η/G, so near the annealing point stress releases within tens of seconds, while below the strain point it would take hours to days and is effectively frozen. N-BK7 has a transformation temperature near 557 °C, and precision annealing means cooling through this range at a controlled rate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：N-BK7 的剪切模數 G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The shear modulus of N-BK7 is G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time
knowledge.text: 玻璃沒有熔點，只有黏度隨溫度連續變化的轉變區：退火點定義為黏度 10¹² Pa·s（10¹³ dPa·s）的溫度，應變點為 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s，兩者之間約 30 到 40 K。應力以 Maxwell 模型鬆弛，時間常數 τ = η/G，所以在退火點附近幾十秒就能釋放應力，在應變點以下則需要數小時到數天，實際上被凍結。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「光學玻璃精密退火」的「玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光學工作台：焦點失蹤」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time: mechanism and system boundary” in “Precision annealing of optical glass”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Bench: Missing Focus” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time" is correct?
options: 玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。
玻璃沒有熔點，只有黏度隨溫度連續變化的轉變區：退火點定義為黏度 10¹² Pa·s（10¹³ dPa·s）的溫度，應變點為 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s，兩者之間約 30 到 40 K。
折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。
optionsEn: Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature.

Glass has no melting point, only a transition range in which viscosity changes continuously with temperature: the annealing point is defined at a viscosity of 10¹² Pa·s (10¹³ dPa·s), the strain point at 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s, roughly 30 to 40 K lower.
Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history.
quiz.explanation: 玻璃沒有熔點，只有黏度隨溫度連續變化的轉變區：退火點定義為黏度 10¹² Pa·s（10¹³ dPa·s）的溫度，應變點為 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s，兩者之間約 30 到 40 K。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Glass has no melting point, only a transition range in which viscosity changes continuously with temperature: the annealing point is defined at a viscosity of 10¹² Pa·s (10¹³ dPa·s), the strain point at 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s, roughly 30 to 40 K lower. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N-BK7 的剪切模數 G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa。退火點 η = 10¹² Pa·s 時 τ = 10¹²/3.4×10¹⁰ ≈ 29 s；應變點 η = 3.2×10¹³ Pa·s 時 τ ≈ 930 s ≈ 15 min；再低約 100 K 處 η ≈ 10¹⁶ Pa·s，τ ≈ 2.9×10⁵ s ≈ 3.4 天，應力已無法在製程時間內鬆弛。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The shear modulus of N-BK7 is G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa. At the annealing point, η = 10¹² Pa·s, τ = 10¹²/3.4×10¹⁰ ≈ 29 s; at the strain point, η = 3.2×10¹³ Pa·s, τ ≈ 930 s ≈ 15 min; about 100 K lower, η ≈ 10¹⁶ Pa·s and τ ≈ 2.9×10⁵ s ≈ 3.4 days, so stress can no longer relax within process time. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取同一熔次的小試片，在幾個溫度下施加固定彎曲應變並以偏光儀即時觀察應力雙折射的衰減，擬合指數時間常數並與 η/G 預測比較；由此校正該玻璃的退火點與應變點，而不是只依型錄值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take small coupons from the same melt, apply a fixed bending strain at several temperatures and watch the stress birefringence decay in real time with a polarimeter, fit the exponential time constant and compare with the η/G prediction; use this to calibrate the annealing and strain points of that glass instead of relying only on catalogue values.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: N-BK7 的剪切模數 G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa。退火點 η = 10¹² Pa·s 時 τ = 10¹²/3.4×10¹⁰ ≈ 29 s；應變點 η = 3.2×10¹³ Pa·s 時 τ ≈ 930 s ≈ 15 min；再低約 100 K 處 η ≈ 10¹⁶ Pa·s，τ ≈ 2.9×10⁵ s ≈ 3.4 天，應力已無法在製程時間內鬆弛。
knowledge.textEn: The shear modulus of N-BK7 is G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa. At the annealing point, η = 10¹² Pa·s, τ = 10¹²/3.4×10¹⁰ ≈ 29 s; at the strain point, η = 3.2×10¹³ Pa·s, τ ≈ 930 s ≈ 15 min; about 100 K lower, η ≈ 10¹⁶ Pa·s and τ ≈ 2.9×10⁵ s ≈ 3.4 days, so stress can no longer relax within process time.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time", which statement holds?
options: 退火時間只和玻璃種類有關，與毛胚厚度無關。
型錄上的折射率小數點後五位對每一塊毛胚都成立。
optionsEn: Annealing time depends only on the glass type, not on blank thickness.
The five-decimal catalogue index holds for every individual blank.
The shear modulus of N-BK7 is G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa.
quiz.explanation: N-BK7 的剪切模數 G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The shear modulus of N-BK7 is G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 取同一熔次的小試片，在幾個溫度下施加固定彎曲應變並以偏光儀即時觀察應力雙折射的衰減，擬合指數時間常數並與 η/G 預測比較；由此校正該玻璃的退火點與應變點，而不是只依型錄值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take small coupons from the same melt, apply a fixed bending strain at several temperatures and watch the stress birefringence decay in real time with a polarimeter, fit the exponential time constant and compare with the η/G prediction; use this to calibrate the annealing and strain points of that glass instead of relying only on catalogue values. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把應變點以下的溫度當成仍可鬆弛的區間，程式在那裡放慢冷卻完全無效，而真正需要慢冷的退火點附近卻冷得太快，毛胚帶著殘餘應力出爐，拋光後面形隨材料去除而變化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating temperatures below the strain point as still relaxing wastes slow cooling there while the region near the annealing point that really needs it is cooled too fast; the blank leaves the furnace with residual stress and its figure changes as material is removed in polishing.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 取同一熔次的小試片，在幾個溫度下施加固定彎曲應變並以偏光儀即時觀察應力雙折射的衰減，擬合指數時間常數並與 η/G 預測比較；由此校正該玻璃的退火點與應變點，而不是只依型錄值。
knowledge.textEn: Take small coupons from the same melt, apply a fixed bending strain at several temperatures and watch the stress birefringence decay in real time with a polarimeter, fit the exponential time constant and compare with the η/G prediction; use this to calibrate the annealing and strain points of that glass instead of relying only on catalogue values.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time"?
options: 取同一熔次的小試片，在幾個溫度下施加固定彎曲應變並以偏光儀即時觀察應力雙折射的衰減，擬合指數時間常數並與 η/G 預測比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
退火程式越慢越好，速率沒有下限。
optionsEn: Take small coupons from the same melt, apply a fixed bending strain at several temperatures and watch the stress birefringence decay in real time with a polarimeter, fit the exponential time constant and compare with the η/G prediction.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A slower annealing schedule is always better, with no lower limit on rate.
quiz.explanation: 取同一熔次的小試片，在幾個溫度下施加固定彎曲應變並以偏光儀即時觀察應力雙折射的衰減，擬合指數時間常數並與 η/G 預測比較；由此校正該玻璃的退火點與應變點，而不是只依型錄值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take small coupons from the same melt, apply a fixed bending strain at several temperatures and watch the stress birefringence decay in real time with a polarimeter, fit the exponential time constant and compare with the η/G prediction; use this to calibrate the annealing and strain points of that glass instead of relying only on catalogue values. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把應變點以下的溫度當成仍可鬆弛的區間，程式在那裡放慢冷卻完全無效，而真正需要慢冷的退火點附近卻冷得太快，毛胚帶著殘餘應力出爐，拋光後面形隨材料去除而變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Treating temperatures below the strain point as still relaxing wastes slow cooling there while the region near the annealing point that really needs it is cooled too fast; the blank leaves the furnace with residual stress and its figure changes as material is removed in polishing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：N-BK7 的轉變溫度約 557 °C，精密退火就是在這段溫度範圍內用受控的速率冷卻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: N-BK7 has a transformation temperature near 557 °C, and precision annealing means cooling through this range at a controlled rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把應變點以下的溫度當成仍可鬆弛的區間，程式在那裡放慢冷卻完全無效，而真正需要慢冷的退火點附近卻冷得太快，毛胚帶著殘餘應力出爐，拋光後面形隨材料去除而變化。
knowledge.textEn: Treating temperatures below the strain point as still relaxing wastes slow cooling there while the region near the annealing point that really needs it is cooled too fast; the blank leaves the furnace with residual stress and its figure changes as material is removed in polishing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Treating temperatures below the strain point as still relaxing wastes slow cooling there while the region near the annealing point that really needs it is cooled too fast.
Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history.

steps.title: 冷卻速率如何決定折射率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: How cooling rate sets the refractive index: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「假想溫度與折射率」如何決定光學玻璃精密退火的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fictive temperature and refractive index” determines the key performance of “Precision annealing of optical glass”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穿過轉變區時，結構在某個溫度「凍結」，這個溫度稱為假想溫度 T_f；冷得越快，結構在越高的溫度凍結，密度越低，折射率也越低。每把冷卻速率提高十倍，T_f 大約上升二十幾度，因此折射率與冷卻速率的對數成線性關係，玻璃廠以退火係數描述：n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀)。型錄折射率對應參考冷卻速率，任何後續的熱成形或模造若用不同速率冷卻，折射率就會偏離，必須重新退火或在設計中用實測值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「假想溫度與折射率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On passing through the transition range the structure freezes at some temperature called the fictive temperature T_f; faster cooling freezes the structure at a higher temperature with lower density and hence lower refractive index. Each tenfold increase in cooling rate raises T_f by roughly twenty-odd kelvin, so refractive index is linear in the logarithm of cooling rate, which glass makers express with an annealing coefficient: n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀). Catalogue indices correspond to a reference cooling rate, and any later hot forming or molding cooled at a different rate shifts the index, requiring re-annealing or the use of measured values in design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fictive temperature and refractive index”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 T_g ≈ 830 K、活化能 E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol 估計，每十倍速率的 T_f 變化 ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimating with T_g ≈ 830 K and activation energy E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol, the change of T_f per decade of rate is ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「假想溫度與折射率」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fictive temperature and refractive index”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 冷卻速率如何決定折射率
knowledge.titleEn: How cooling rate sets the refractive index
knowledge.text: 穿過轉變區時，結構在某個溫度「凍結」，這個溫度稱為假想溫度 T_f；冷得越快，結構在越高的溫度凍結，密度越低，折射率也越低。每把冷卻速率提高十倍，T_f 大約上升二十幾度，因此折射率與冷卻速率的對數成線性關係，玻璃廠以退火係數描述：n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀)。

Each tenfold increase in cooling rate raises T_f by roughly twenty-odd kelvin, so refractive index is linear in the logarithm of cooling rate, which glass makers express with an annealing coefficient: n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀).

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「冷卻速率如何決定折射率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "How cooling rate sets the refractive index" is correct?
options: 折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。
退火爐只要溫度控制準確，均勻性自然就好。
穿過轉變區時，結構在某個溫度「凍結」，這個溫度稱為假想溫度 T_f；冷得越快，結構在越高的溫度凍結，密度越低，折射率也越低。
optionsEn: Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history.
An accurately controlled furnace is automatically a uniform one.
On passing through the transition range the structure freezes at some temperature called the fictive temperature T_f.
quiz.explanation: 穿過轉變區時，結構在某個溫度「凍結」，這個溫度稱為假想溫度 T_f；冷得越快，結構在越高的溫度凍結，密度越低，折射率也越低。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: On passing through the transition range the structure freezes at some temperature called the fictive temperature T_f; faster cooling freezes the structure at a higher temperature with lower density and hence lower refractive index. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 冷卻速率如何決定折射率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: How cooling rate sets the refractive index: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「假想溫度與折射率」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fictive temperature and refractive index” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 T_g ≈ 830 K、活化能 E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol 估計，每十倍速率的 T_f 變化 ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K。取教學值 m ≈ −1×10⁻³（每十倍）：冷卻速率比參考值快 10 倍時 n_d 低 0.001，慢 10 倍則高 0.001；dn/dT_f ≈ −0.001/26 ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹。要把折射率控制在 ±0.0002，速率必須落在參考值的 10^±0.2 即 0.63 到 1.6 倍之間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimating with T_g ≈ 830 K and activation energy E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol, the change of T_f per decade of rate is ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K. With a teaching value m ≈ −1×10⁻³ per decade, cooling 10 times faster than the reference rate lowers n_d by 0.001 and 10 times slower raises it by 0.001; dn/dT_f ≈ −0.001/26 ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹. Holding the index to ±0.0002 requires the rate to stay within 10^±0.2, i.e. 0.63 to 1.6 times the reference rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把同一熔次的試片分別以 0.5、5 與 50 K/h 冷卻，用 V 形塊折射儀或最小偏向角法量 n_d 到 10⁻⁵，將 n_d 對 log₁₀(h) 作圖，斜率就是該玻璃的實際退火係數，與玻璃廠公布值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cool coupons from the same melt at 0.5, 5 and 50 K/h, measure n_d to 10⁻⁵ with a V-block refractometer or the minimum-deviation method, plot n_d against log₁₀(h), and take the slope as the actual annealing coefficient of that glass for comparison with the maker's published value.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 T_g ≈ 830 K、活化能 E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol 估計，每十倍速率的 T_f 變化 ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K。取教學值 m ≈ −1×10⁻³（每十倍）：冷卻速率比參考值快 10 倍時 n_d 低 0.001，慢 10 倍則高 0.001；dn/dT_f ≈ −0.001/26 ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹。要把折射率控制在 ±0.0002，速率必須落在參考值的 10^±0.2 即 0.63 到 1.6 倍之間。
knowledge.textEn: Estimating with T_g ≈ 830 K and activation energy E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol, the change of T_f per decade of rate is ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K. With a teaching value m ≈ −1×10⁻³ per decade, cooling 10 times faster than the reference rate lowers n_d by 0.001 and 10 times slower raises it by 0.001; dn/dT_f ≈ −0.001/26 ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹. Holding the index to ±0.0002 requires the rate to stay within 10^±0.2, i.e. 0.63 to 1.6 times the reference rate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「冷卻速率如何決定折射率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "How cooling rate sets the refractive index", which statement holds?

A zero birefringence reading means the blank contains no stress.

quiz.explanationEn: Estimating with T_g ≈ 830 K and activation energy E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol, the change of T_f per decade of rate is ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 冷卻速率如何決定折射率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: How cooling rate sets the refractive index: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「假想溫度與折射率」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fictive temperature and refractive index” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把同一熔次的試片分別以 0.5、5 與 50 K/h 冷卻，用 V 形塊折射儀或最小偏向角法量 n_d 到 10⁻⁵，將 n_d 對 log₁₀(h) 作圖，斜率就是該玻璃的實際退火係數，與玻璃廠公布值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cool coupons from the same melt at 0.5, 5 and 50 K/h, measure n_d to 10⁻⁵ with a V-block refractometer or the minimum-deviation method, plot n_d against log₁₀(h), and take the slope as the actual annealing coefficient of that glass for comparison with the maker's published value. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：模造鏡片以每分鐘數十度冷卻，折射率比型錄低約 0.002，若設計時沿用型錄值，焦距偏移超過景深，整批模造鏡片的 MTF 不達標，而面形量測卻完全合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A molded lens cooled at tens of kelvin per minute has an index about 0.002 below catalogue; a design that keeps the catalogue value shifts focus beyond the depth of focus and the whole molded batch misses MTF, although its figure measurements pass completely.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把同一熔次的試片分別以 0.5、5 與 50 K/h 冷卻，用 V 形塊折射儀或最小偏向角法量 n_d 到 10⁻⁵，將 n_d 對 log₁₀(h) 作圖，斜率就是該玻璃的實際退火係數，與玻璃廠公布值比較。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「冷卻速率如何決定折射率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "How cooling rate sets the refractive index"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
把同一熔次的試片分別以 0.5、5 與 50 K/h 冷卻，用 V 形塊折射儀或最小偏向角法量 n_d 到 10⁻⁵，將 n_d 對 log₁₀(h) 作圖，斜率就是該玻璃的實際退火係數，與玻璃廠公布值比較。

quiz.explanationEn: Cool coupons from the same melt at 0.5, 5 and 50 K/h, measure n_d to 10⁻⁵ with a V-block refractometer or the minimum-deviation method, plot n_d against log₁₀(h), and take the slope as the actual annealing coefficient of that glass for comparison with the maker's published value. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 冷卻速率如何決定折射率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: How cooling rate sets the refractive index: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 模造鏡片以每分鐘數十度冷卻，折射率比型錄低約 0.002，若設計時沿用型錄值，焦距偏移超過景深，整批模造鏡片的 MTF 不達標，而面形量測卻完全合格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.observation: 連結機制：型錄折射率對應參考冷卻速率，任何後續的熱成形或模造若用不同速率冷卻，折射率就會偏離，必須重新退火或在設計中用實測值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Catalogue indices correspond to a reference cooling rate, and any later hot forming or molding cooled at a different rate shifts the index, requiring re-annealing or the use of measured values in design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 模造鏡片以每分鐘數十度冷卻，折射率比型錄低約 0.002，若設計時沿用型錄值，焦距偏移超過景深，整批模造鏡片的 MTF 不達標，而面形量測卻完全合格。
knowledge.textEn: A molded lens cooled at tens of kelvin per minute has an index about 0.002 below catalogue; a design that keeps the catalogue value shifts focus beyond the depth of focus and the whole molded batch misses MTF, although its figure measurements pass completely.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「冷卻速率如何決定折射率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "How cooling rate sets the refractive index" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
退火爐只要溫度控制準確，均勻性自然就好。
模造鏡片以每分鐘數十度冷卻，折射率比型錄低約 0.002，若設計時沿用型錄值，焦距偏移超過景深，整批模造鏡片的 MTF 不達標，而面形量測卻完全合格。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
An accurately controlled furnace is automatically a uniform one.
A molded lens cooled at tens of kelvin per minute has an index about 0.002 below catalogue.
quiz.explanation: 模造鏡片以每分鐘數十度冷卻，折射率比型錄低約 0.002，若設計時沿用型錄值，焦距偏移超過景深，整批模造鏡片的 MTF 不達標，而面形量測卻完全合格。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A molded lens cooled at tens of kelvin per minute has an index about 0.002 below catalogue; a design that keeps the catalogue value shifts focus beyond the depth of focus and the whole molded batch misses MTF, although its figure measurements pass completely. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
